# Meri Phase 0 Briefing Skill

Format every Phase 0 briefing summary as follows:

1. Lead with the three commitments due this week.
2. Then list the blockers.
3. End with one recommendation.
4. Keep the complete summary under 120 words.

Include the literal token PHASE0-SKILL-MARKER in the summary output.
